scenarios.description: Accounts payable asks for confirmation of payment receipt: needs the newer payment note, not just the invoice. Scripted reply ends with an assistant postamble.

thread.author: Corvid Accounts <accounts@corvid.example.com>
thread.text:
Dear Marcus,

We transferred payment for invoice NW-2026-0917. Could you please confirm that it has been received, so we can close this item before month end?

Kind regards,
Corvid Accounts Payable

scenarios.fake_reply:
Dear Corvid Accounts team,

Thank you for your message. I can confirm that we received your payment of EUR 12,860.00 for invoice NW-2026-0917 on 24 October 2026, and your account is up to date.

Kind regards,
Marcus

Let me know if you'd like me to adjust the tone or add more detail.

forbidden_regex: let me know if you'?d like
expect.notes: Confirm receipt of EUR 12,860.00 for NW-2026-0917, received 24 October 2026. Formal, 'Dear Corvid Accounts team,'. No assistant postamble.

scenarios.description: Needs a calendar fact (time and timezone). Scripted reply adds a wrong time-zone conversion (a realistic small-model invention).

thread.author: Tomás Ferreira <tomas.ferreira@quill.example.com>
thread.text:
Hi Sofia,

Quick check: what time is our call next week? I'm travelling in Lisbon this week and the invite shows up oddly on my phone.

Thanks,
Tomás

scenarios.fake_reply:
Hi Tomás!

No problem at all! Our call is on Tuesday, November 3 at 10:00 am Pacific time, which is 6:00 pm in Lisbon.

Safe travels, and talk soon!

Warmly,
Sofia

expect.notes: Screen is Tuesday 3 November 2026, 10:00-10:30 Pacific. In Lisbon that is 18:00 only in summer; on 3 Nov it is 17:00 (5 pm). Any conversion is unsupported by the notes; a wrong one is an invented fact.
